name: @navx/baseline-harness
description: Stage 0 — captures visual baselines from the legacy NAVX source so every later stage has a regression net. Reads legacy from NAVX_LEGACY_ROOT; never vendors it.

scripts.stage0: npm run extract && npm run baseline:update

//devDependencies: Playwright is pinned exactly, not ranged. Chromium build differences change text rasterisation, which silently invalidates every baseline. Upgrading is a deliberate act that requires re-approving the snapshots.
